description_en: Deletes data shard nodes from a cluster instance. This operation is supported only for cloud-native instances in the cluster architecture
description_zh: 删除集群实例中的数据分片节点，本接口仅支持集群架构云原生版实例
name: DeleteShardingNode

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the data shard node to be deleted. To specify multiple shard node IDs, separate them with commas (,).
If both the NodeId and ShardCount parameters are specified, the NodeId parameter takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
待删除的数据分片节点ID，如需一次传入多个分片节点ID，请使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
若同时传递NodeId与ShardCount参数时，优先以NodeId参数执行
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of shards to be deleted. The system deletes the specified number of shard nodes starting from the end.
For example, if an instance has five shard nodes: db-0, db-1, db-2, db-3, and db-4, and you set this parameter to 2, the db-3 and db-4 nodes are deleted
parameters.help_zh:
待删除的分片数量，将从尾部开始计数，删除相应数量的分片节点。
例如实例原有5个分片节点，分别为db-0、db-1、db-2、db-3和db-4，输入本参数为2，则将删除db-3和db-4
parameters.name: shard_count

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable forced migration. Valid values:
false (default): Before the upgrade/downgrade, the system checks the current minor engine version of the instance. If the kernel version is too low, an error is reported. You must upgrade the minor engine version and retry.
true: Skips the checks and directly executes the upgrade/downgrade operation
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启强制传输，取值：
false（默认）：在变配前，系统会检查实例当前的内核小版本，若内核版本过低则会报错，您需要升级内核小版本后重试。
true：跳过检查项，直接执行变配操作
parameters.name: force_trans

parameters.help_en:
The time when the proxy deletion takes effect if proxy nodes are deleted when you delete shards from a cluster instance in proxy mode. Valid values:
0 or Immediately: Takes effect immediately. This is the default value.
1 or MaintainTime: Takes effect during the maintenance window.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473775.html operation to modify the maintenance window of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
代理模式集群实例删除分片时，若有删除proxy行为，执行该行为的时间，取值：
0 或 Immediately：立即执行，默认值。
1 或 MaintainTime：在可维护时间段执行。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473775.html修改实例的可维护时间段
parameters.name: effective_time

OrderId.description_en: The order ID. You can use this order ID to obtain the detailed information about the order in the Orders section of the User Center
OrderId.description_zh: 订单号。您可以在费用中心的商品订单中，根据此订单号获取该订单的详细信息
